title: agora.errors/v1
description: Stable reason codes and the JSON error body of every non-2xx HTTP answer (R07).

ReasonCode.description: Closed set of stable reason codes in use on the foundation surface. A new code is a contract change.

ErrorReport.description: Error body. Carries a reason code and a correlation id, never a secret value. details lists validator paths and messages for malformed_command.
